summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to an intellectual property license agreement with BP United Inc. The amendment reallocates a $5 million payment from BP United to the registrant for manufacturing ramp-up, changes consulting services, and establishes vesting terms for consideration shares. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or other special-situation transaction is involved. This is a routine contractual amendment.
